title: UpdateRowsConfig
description: JSONObject with configuration for updating rows.

columns.description: JSONObject with column name as key and data as value.

criteria.description: If criteria is sent, then the rows matching the criteria alone are updated.

updateAllRows.description: To update all the rows in the table.

addIfNotExist.description: It controls whether to add a new row with the provided details if the provided criteria doesn't matches with the existing data.

dateFormat.description: Specify this in-case any date field is being added and its format cannot be auto recognized.

columnDateFormat.description: Specify this in case multiple date fields are being imported having different format each. Column name as key and date format as value.
